## Querying APIs

- API:

  - Application Programming Interface

  - A protocol for computers to talk to each other, allowing us to grab data from systems.

  - Also we can set up APIs to allow others access to our data

  - Many websites have require an API key

- The API for the USA Census (census.gov) is accessible through a package `tidycensus`j

```{r}
library(tidycensus)
```

- Try `get_acs()` to obtain data from the American Community Survey
